items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Not sure, that's not what Sammy Penn does in these acts. No, no. Sammy Penn sings.

ctx.x: No, they would blow on it. Blow on it? Yeah, blow on it. Some effect against the snare and with the head, you see, and the effect of the snare on it, it would give a sound.
Not sure, that's not what Sammy Penn does in these acts. No, no. Sammy Penn sings.
He sings to it somewhere to make it rattle along with him. No, my father didn't sing. Would you think it might be the vibration of the lips like when you play a trumpet or something like that?
